ApiError.description: Safe error payload for all operations; messages must not contain credentials or private diagnostics.

code.description: Stable machine-readable failure category; callers should branch on this rather than message text.

details.description: Optional structured diagnostic object; omission differs from explicit JSON null, which is rejected.

message.description: Human-readable safe diagnostic; never include credentials or raw private exception details.

DescribeResult.description: Result of `GET /api/v1/describe`; versions, caller identity and operation discovery.

ErrorCode.description: Stable error categories used by every operation failure; each maps to one HTTP status.

oneOf.description: Authentication is missing or invalid (HTTP 401).
Current authority does not permit the operation (HTTP 403).
The requested resource or operation is unavailable (HTTP 404).
The expected revision or durable retry input conflicts (HTTP 409).
Input violates the contract (HTTP 400 in operation errors).
The serialized body or document exceeds its byte budget (HTTP 413).
The operation cannot currently be served (HTTP 503).
An internal failure occurred; expose only safe diagnostics (HTTP 500 in operation errors).
